IDT12420.synoptic: In the wake of a trough which crossed Tasmania overnight, a cold southwesterly airstream is forecast persist this morning. A high will pass to the north of Tasmania later tonight and move to the east of the state by early Wednesday, where it is expected to slowly move east during Thursday and Friday while maintaining a weak ridge over Tasmania.
